headline: Trump Media Shares Fall to Record Low Following Midterm Elections
summary: Trump Media & Technology Group's stock plummeted 24 percent a day after Democrats achieved significant gains in the midterm elections.
why: Trump Media & Technology Group operates the Truth Social platform, making its equity highly sensitive to political shifts and sentiment surrounding Donald Trump.

impacts.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
impacts.why: The company's stock plunged 24 percent following the midterm election results.
